verdict.rationale: New Relic's alerts docs say you define 'who is notified, and how' and can 'route issues to the correct system or team using notifications,' which implies outbound event delivery to external systems. Webhooks are never explicitly named, so this is only glancing support. Missing for 10: explicit webhook destination documentation, event types available for subscription, payload format and security (signing/retries), and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
